name: window-sidecar-listen-cids
description: The page registers the session tab-cids of the sidecar @x/cids, receives a message with the identifiers of the request it answers and a message without identifiers, and then removes the registration.
reason: The case delivers sidecar-message notices to the page, and the Go producer runs no window to receive a notice (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
